axisRules: Letterform and composition change geometry; practice context and rendering never do.
Blockbuster is not an alphabet: straight letterform plus block-fit composition.
Wildstyle is a composition and relationship grammar. Interlocking needs the relationship solver (C04); until then the composition step is skipped and reported.
Throw-up is a practice/form context, not a letterform; it does not force bubble geometry.
Bounce is a word-level composition: it never changes a glyph's own geometry, only its placement in the word.

letterform.bubble.inflate.labelDe: Masse aufblasen (Kontur nach außen, Punzen werden zu Schlitzen)

letterform.bubble.swell-sides.labelDe: Außenseiten wölben (nur zwischen zwei konvexen Ecken, damit Lücken zwischen Armen offen bleiben)

composition.bounce.labelDe: Buchstaben im Wort wippen, kippen und überlappen

parameterPolicy: Grammar defaults chosen for the authored family (stroke 23–26 units). Not calibrated against reviewed reference pieces; the resolver tries candidates in order and keeps the first one that passes validation.
validationGates: hard geometry checks of src/glyph/validate-geometry.js pass on the derived geometry
same number of counters as the neutral master

missingCapability.unsupportedGlyph: neutral-fallback: the glyph is returned unchanged with reason
missingCapability.operationFails: the operation is skipped with reason; earlier operations stay applied
missingCapability.compositionUnavailable: skipped with reason; the letterform result stands alone
